top_signals.title: Trump Puts 81 Million Gulf Acres Up for Oil and Gas Auction
top_signals.summary: The Trump administration will put oil and gas leases covering more than 81 million acres in the Gulf of Mexico up for auction on Wednesday, August 12, in the third of 30 Gulf lease sales mandated under President Donald Trump’s 2025 tax and spending law. Wednesday’s auction is also the second Gulf lease sale since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began in February, disrupting Middle East crude supplies and sending oil prices to four-year highs. Brent crude was trading above $89 per barrel on Wednesday. The Interior Department will offer…

top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs to Buy Neos Investments for $2.25 Billion
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group will pay as much as $2.25 billion to buy Neos Investments, expanding its asset manager’s reach in the actively managed ETF market. Katherine Doherty reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Cava Rises on Sales; CoreWeave Sores on AI Outlook | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Cava (CAVA) is also rising this morning as sales jumped with Americans flocking to Pita Chips, Salmon, and other Mediterranean-diet oriented foods.
- Super Micro (SMCI) is giving a sales outlook that topped even the rosiest projections. That along with Coreweave's report is sending markets higher.
- CoreWeave (CRWV) is soaring after booming AI demand bolstered the company's revenue outlook. Nebius (NBIS) is also up this morning with earnings coming out. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
